description: This is an index.html file that serves as the front-end for a database viewer web application. It contains HTML structure, embedded CSS styles for layout and presentation, and JavaScript code for fetching data from backend API endpoints, dynamically updating the UI, and handling user interactions to browse databases, tables, and their data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the backend API and populates the sidebar list.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resets current selections, and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database, and initiates loading tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches the list of tables for a selected database from the backend API.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table within the current database.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML to display table data, including headers and cell contents, with considerations for wide content and null values.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual table cells, handling data types, special formatting for objects, long strings, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Handles expanding and collapsing cell content when a cell is clicked, toggling between summary and full content.
